### KeySelector
KeySelector is a selector for selecting specific attributes by their keys.


| Field | Type | Label | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----- | ----------- |
| keys | [bytes](https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/proto3#scalar) | repeated | <p>keys is the list of attribute keys to select.</p> |
